dissented.cause: dispatch._balanced_body balances braces on the raw helper body rather than on masked(), so a } inside a string literal or inside a block comment truncates the body mid-token. render._body was repaired to balance on the mask for exactly this reason; dispatch._balanced_body was not. Two readers, one question, two answers.

The 21 non-frame workflows are held to a demotion sentence plus a position rule that reaches 3 of 89 splices. Independently measured and matching the account's own disclosure. Any prose appended after the label in those files is ungraded.

sov-loop.js now delivers built.summary to the witness. The base commit 64fe985 did not - its prompts said the evaluator receives 'never the builder reasoning'. The artifact moved from withholding the builder's account to delivering it under a label. SDLC.md gate 6 permits Red to read the builder's plan, so this is admissible, but it raises what the labelling has to carry, and F1 shows the label can be countermanded invisibly downstream.

UNREACHABLE entry 'cannot read expression at' appears genuinely unreachable, but for a reason other than the one recorded: render._literals always advances at least one index, so index == start cannot occur. The recorded reason (prompt_of returns whole arguments) is not what pre-empts it.
